Measure resistance between coaxial cable and 
 shield (fig .1) the measuring value should be equal to (0.8/1.2 Ώ 
 ) and also the measuring value between surface / coaxial cable, 
 surface / shield should be tends to ∞ Ω.
If the measuring value in step 1 is not the value 
 (0.8/1.2 Ω, ∞ Ω 
 ) then the transducer is defected and should be changed.
